rules: every correction of a verifier check: the earlier check stays in CHECKS.json unchanged; before, after and cause are recorded here for the coordinator; acceptance rules are never widened

before.result: FAIL: results 342 files, 319 identical, 2 identical after sanitiser, 21 differ (all CSV)

after.result: PASS: code 36/35/1 and results 342/319/23 equal SOURCE_ADMISSION.json; nothing differs or is missing

changes.cause: verifier bug: V1 decoded the local text files' raw bytes (keeping CRLF line endings of 21 CSV files) before applying the source sanitiser, whereas the source publication build (mechanism_design.publish_build.build) reads text with Path.read_text() (universal newlines, CRLF -> LF) and then sanitises; V2 emulates the build exactly. The 21 CSVs differ from the published blobs only by CRLF vs LF (probe: raw.replace(CRLF, LF) has the published blob id)
changes.acceptance_rule: unchanged: every published file must equal the local file byte for byte or after the source build's own text transformation; the counts must equal SOURCE_ADMISSION.json

before.result: ATTENTION: guard none bitwise invariant for CONT, LOC, PAIR; the static control did not change theta

changes.cause: verifier bug in the sensitivity control only: V1 compared guard 'static' at targets {0.005, 0.005} and {1, 1}; with equal men / women targets the per-person weights are equal after normalization, so 'static' is invariant too and the control could not show sensitivity. V2 uses {0.005, 0.005} vs {0.0001, 0.5}. The registered criterion (theta bitwise invariant to targets under guard none, three arms, three targets dicts) was met in V1 and is unchanged
changes.acceptance_rule: unchanged: bitwise invariance of theta to targets under guard none (RULES.md 8.1); the control is a test of the test
